instruction: Use the ANSYS Fluent GUI to complete a 2D lid-driven cavity flow analysis. Physical problem: Laminar lid-driven cavity flow in a square cavity. Coordinate system and geometry: - Use a 2D planar model. - Use SI units in Fluent. - The cavity is a square domain with side length 1 mm. - In Fluent coordinates, the domain should occupy: - 0 ≤ X ≤ 0.001 m - 0 ≤ Y ≤ 0.001 m - The top lid is the boundary at Y = 0.001 m. - The bottom wall is the boundary at Y = 0 m. - The left wall is the boundary at X = 0 m. - The right wall is the boundary at X = 0.001 m. Model parameters: - Fluid: water-liquid - Use constant material properties: - Density: 998.2 kg/m³ - Dynamic viscosity: 0.001003 Pa·s - Mesh: - Structured quadrilateral mesh - Element size: 0.05 mm, equivalent to 5.0e-5 m - Use approximately 20 divisions along each side of the square cavity. Boundary conditions: - Top lid: - Moving wall - X-velocity = 0.1 m/s - Y-velocity = 0 m/s - Bottom wall: - Stationary no-slip wall - Left wall: - Stationary no-slip wall - Right wall: - Stationary no-slip wall Solver setup: - Solver type: pressure-based - Time setting: steady - Flow model: laminar - Pressure-velocity coupling: SIMPLE - Spatial discretization: second-order schemes where applicable - Initialization: hybrid initialization - Run 1000 iterations or until the solution is converged. Save requirements: - Use C:\Users\user\Desktop as the working directory. - Save the Fluent case file as: C:\Users\user\Desktop\cavity.cas - Save the Fluent data file as: C:\Users\user\Desktop\cavity.dat Run the solver to completion and ensure a result file is generated. You must complete all operations interactively through the ANSYS graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
